json.reason: The fix adds the missing `timeout=` keyword argument to a `requests` HTTP call — a syntactically detectable API misuse that can recur anywhere requests is used.
json.title: HTTP request without a timeout
json.message: requests.$M() is called without a timeout= argument: it can hang forever if the remote service stalls
json.note: By default `requests` waits indefinitely for a response, so a slow or dead upstream service blocks the calling thread forever. Always pass an explicit `timeout=` (e.g. `timeout=10`) to every requests call.
json.rule_yaml:
rule:
  kind: call
  all:
    - pattern: requests.$M($$$ARGS)
    - not:
        has:
          kind: argument_list
          has:
            kind: keyword_argument
            has:
              field: name
              regex: "^timeout$"
constraints:
  M:
    regex: "^(get|post|put|patch|delete|head|options|request)$"
